name: Tennessee

jury_list.official_pipeline: T.C.A. 2-2-113: voter lists go to federal courts for jury selection on condition that the jury coordinator sends the Coordinator of Elections a list of persons disqualified or potentially disqualified as non-citizens (name, addresses, phone, DOB, reason). The Coordinator verifies registration and forwards to the county administrator, who follows 2-2-106 or 2-2-141 (notice; 30 days to prove citizenship; purge).

sources.cite: T.C.A. 2-2-113 (jury coordinator list to Coordinator of Elections) - Justia copy of the 2025 Tennessee Code
T.C.A. 2-2-141 (citizenship verification; 30 days; purge) - Justia copy

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person who certifies on a state form that the list will be used for political purposes (T.C.A. 2-2-138(b)(1)); in large counties, any interested citizen (2-2-138(c)).
voter_file.use_restriction: T.C.A. 2-2-138(b)(1): 'This list shall be available to any person who certifies on a form provided by the state election commission that such list will be used for political purposes.' 2-2-138(e): 'This list shall be available for purchase to any person who certifies on a form provided by the state election commission that such list will be used for political purposes only.'
voter_file.attestation_required: Certification on the State Election Commission form that the list will be used for political purposes (T.C.A. 2-2-138(b)(1)).

private_challenge.who: At the polls: any person present may challenge; the judges decide after an oath (T.C.A. 2-7-123). No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found.

county_board.name: Tennessee county election commissions (Secretary of State directory)

state_election_office.name: Tennessee Secretary of State - Division of Elections

gates.basis: Jury non-citizen lists go to the Coordinator of Elections (T.C.A. 2-2-113); public status unknown (null). No private pre-election challenge found. Strict gates: counts only.
